observation_summary: The compiler incorrectly reports a code change when no actual changes have been made, causing an assertion failure in the test suite.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the compiler fails to handle empty JS modules during the initialization phase. When a module is empty, the cross-module code motion logic may trigger unnecessary code change reports or fail to correctly identify the module's structure. The fix introduces a 'fillEmptyModules' method that adds a placeholder file to any empty module, ensuring that all modules have at least one input. This prevents the compiler from entering an inconsistent state where it reports code changes despite no actual modifications occurring, as observed in the failing test case.
